# HORN-Z1 — Chinese Room

This note executes the canonical `maps/chinese-room-slice.horn.json` artifact through the native `%horn` interpreter. HORN owns meaning and authored geometry; Zeppelin owns interaction and execution.

## Authority boundary

The `%horn` interpreter is deliberately thin. It invokes the same transport-neutral HORN adapter proven by Z1-A. The network is a lossy semantic/debug projection; authored geometry and route authority remain only in the canonical HORN document.
